description: Privacy Village at DEF CON 25 covers digital privacy, surveillance, anonymity, and privacy protection techniques. The talks explore tracking, DNS privacy, government surveillance, Tor, password security, and anti-tracking methods.

talks.title: The Internet Already Knows I'm Pregnant
talks.teaser: How internet tracking reveals intimate personal information through data collection and analysis.

talks.title: DNS: Devious Name Services Destroying Privacy & Anonymity
talks.teaser: DNS query monitoring and tracking as a privacy threat to user anonymity.

talks.title: Learning about Government Surveillance Software
talks.teaser: Analysis of government surveillance software tools and their privacy implications.

talks.title: Next Generation Tor Onion Services
talks.teaser: Tor's next-generation onion services architecture and improvements for hidden service security.

talks.title: When Privacy Goes Poof! Why It's Gone and Never Coming Back
talks.teaser: The fundamental erosion of privacy in modern society and the societal implications.

talks.title: Total Recall: Implanting Passwords in Cognitive Memory
talks.teaser: Cognitive techniques for securely memorizing strong passwords without written records.

talks.title: Opt Out or Deauth Trying! AntiTracking Bots & Keystroke Injection
talks.teaser: Anti-tracking techniques and tools for preventing online surveillance and behavioral tracking.
